title: AshenSpire / board-specific native geometry
source: Twelve original October1 concept boards; visually transcribed native vectors, October4
boundary: Design/reference assets only. Board prose, values, deck rules and red EndTurn are not canonical gameplay. Runtime text/state comes from game models.
inlineSvg: IDs are namespaced per asset; repeated inline instances need a per-instance prefix. External references are scoped independently.

resources.icon-shield: Defence / Poise context; runtime label decides

boardColorException: Red buttons are exit/destructive states only. EndTurn keeps the game canonical color rule.
